"And I am Zomaiden, Zoma's vessel.
  The third Adventure Log was
  corrupted by my hand!

"I have waited for a youth like you
  to appear.

"Join my side and I'll give
  half the world to you, {var:1}.

"...I'd like to say, but
  I haven't the authority.

"We were born of a mighty god to
  defile the Adventure Logs and bar
  your way.

"We were granted the great Lord's power...
  We won't let you...
  go any further...

"{var:1}! Why do you defy our god
  and struggle on to live?

"Destruction is our joy.
  Those who die are beautiful.
"Now, breathe your last in my arms!
